# nlohmann/json

Vendored include tree from nlohmann/json v3.11.3:

https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.11.3

Distribution: https://pypi.org/project/nlohmann_json/3.11.3/

Retrieved from `nlohmann_json-3.11.3-py3-none-any.whl`; the wheel's
`nlohmann_json/include/nlohmann/` directory is retained here. `LICENSE` contains
the MIT license. The standalone trace analyzer uses this parser to validate
JSON types without changing protocol binaries.
